title: Lung masking in chest radiograph pneumonia classification: code, splits, predictions and result tables
description: Code, Kaggle notebook outputs and result tables for the study 'Lung masking in chest radiograph pneumonia classification: a leakage-controlled factorial study of discrimination, lesion-level grounding and shortcut reliance' (submitted to Medical Image Analysis). Includes the patient-grouped, duplicate-free split files with fingerprints, per-image predictions of all 36 models, grounding and occlusion tables, statistics and figure scripts. The radiographs themselves are not redistributed; they are available from their original public sources (Kermany et al., Mendeley Data v2; RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge; NIH ChestX-ray14; VinDr-CXR on PhysioNet).
